items.example: They met a long time ago, in 2010.
items.mnemonic: Луна светила a long time ago — давно.

items.example: Back in the day, there was no internet.
items.mnemonic: Диджей жмёт бэк: back in the day — в своё время.

items.example: Life was slow in those days.
items.mnemonic: В дождь in those days — в те дни.

items.idiom: used to live in a village
items.example: She used to live in a small village.
items.mnemonic: Юзер used to live in a village — раньше жил в деревне.

items.example: He looks back on his childhood with love.
items.mnemonic: Заглядывает в бук детства: look back on childhood — вспоминать детство.

items.example: She was born and raised in Madrid.
items.mnemonic: Борщ born and raised in Madrid — родился и вырос в Мадриде.

items.example: We talked about good old times all evening.
items.mnemonic: Олень ностальгирует good old times — старые добрые времена.
